boardRevision: NUCLEO-H563ZI / MB1404 C-01; official schematic pack v2.0 and UM3115 Rev 2 inspected; sprite connector artwork remains provisional

sources.evidence: Board setup connects PA5 at CN7 pin 10 and PA6 at CN9 pin 1.

sources.revision: MB1404 H563ZI C-01, schematic pack v2.0 (2025-01-27); sheet 6/9 is titled Connectors
sources.evidence: ST schematic-pack index and extracted PDF text identify the exact MB1404 H563ZI C-01 drawing and connector sheet. The connector footprint artwork has not been visually aligned to the supplied sprite anchors.

sources.revision: UM3115 Rev 2, STM32H5 Nucleo-144 board MB1404
sources.evidence: Figure 17 identifies physical CN7/CN8/CN9/CN10 locations; Table 21 lists CN7 pin 10 as PA5 and Table 23 lists CN9 pin 1 as PA6.

review.note: ST CubeH5 firmware and UM3115 Rev 2 confirm PA5/CN7-10 and PA6/CN9-1. The official MB1404 C-01 schematic pack v2.0 identifies sheet 6 as Connectors. The supplied sprite README states its connector identities and geometry are provisional; its H563 layout contains CN11/CN12 and ZIO_D/ZIO_A, not CN7/CN9. Mapping evidence is verified, but no artwork contact anchor is established; both contacts remain electrically disabled.
